source: research/s3e-bitstream (see README.md): the pads of the package, absolute bits per pad (gen-iob.mjs; ana-pads.mjs, ana-perpad.mjs); ISE 14.7 xdl P.20131013 + bitgen; 2026-10-11
note: Pad (package pin) -> feature -> bits "frame,bit" of the frame data ("!frame,bit" = cleared). I/O direction and standard (I:LVCMOS33, O:LVCMOS33, IO:…), drive, slew and pull changes (O:DRIVE:8, O:LVTTL:DRIVE:8, O:SLEW:FAST, I:PULL:PULLUP…). I:NOLOAD: an input whose buffer drives nothing (any I/O standard; measured with every pad of the package an unconnected input: ISE's bitgen leaves out one bit of the input and the 2.5 / 3.3 V ones, #18).
